title: Kling Production Spec
description: Human-readable reference for the spec the engine produces and the renderer consumes. The validator of record is src/lib/spec-schema.js (dependency-free, incremental).

render_backend.description: Optional: which backend renders kling.jobs[] (default: RENDER_BACKEND / kling). The engine stamps the canonical `<model>@<provider>` id; the legacy one-word aliases stay valid forever. The spec is backend-neutral; Seedance adds a 4s/job minimum. Keep this enum in sync with ALL_BACKENDS in src/lib/render-models.js.

format.description: e.g. skit, explainer, product_demo, micro_story, trend, ad, pov

aspect_ratio.description: structural superset — each model renders its own subset (aspectsFor in src/lib/render-models.js)

beat.description: e.g. hook, setup, escalation, turn, payoff, button

duration_s.description: structural superset — each model's own per-job ceiling rules (15s on Kling/Seedance 2.0, 30s on Seedance 2.5; capsFor in src/lib/render-models.js)

description.description: optional storyboard note (handed to the Scene Director)

content_prompt.description: scene + action ONLY; no subject appearance words (identity is pinned by reference Elements)

duration.description: optional override of duration_s for this segment

speaker.description: character saying the line; on the fal transport, matched to a registered voice to lock that character's persistent voice_id

aspect_ratio.description: structural superset — each model renders its own subset (aspectsFor in src/lib/render-models.js)

character.description: optional: groups this image with others of the same character; on the fal transport, matched to a registered voice (and to a VO line's speaker) to bind that character's persistent voice_id

jobs.description: one generation each (stitched in array order). Per-model caps rule (capsFor in src/lib/render-models.js): Kling ≤6 shots / ≤15s / ≤7 elements; Seedance ≤9 elements minus 1 reserved for the opening/seam frame on chained jobs. maxItems here is the structural superset.

check.description: prefix a failing check with its owner tag, e.g. [shots], [content], [jobs]
